snippet.title: Sega Saturn - AI Shogi 2 (1998)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
AI Shogi 2 is a Miscellaneous game, developed by ASCII Something Good and published by ASCII Entertainment, which was released in Japan in 1998.
